page.overview:
Who is Shadow-Forger?

They are man-shaped and seemingly made of stone, having skin hard enough to turn aside swords. They move extremely slowly and are very strong. Demandred is not able to tell one forger from another. They have dead eyes and cannot speak. They are not truly alive.

and are rumored to become fierce when provoked. This may not be true as they do not appear to show resistance against Aviendha and her group of channelers when they storm the forge, showing only "a hint of confusion".

Aviendha, by her own admission, did not wish to wait to test that rumor. Transported any distance from Shayol Ghul, they simply turn to stone or dust. They can also be killed by the water in which they quench their blades, which is poisonous enough to kill anyone who touches it.

Demandred notes that they take great care in not touching it. Aviendha kills one by decapitating it with a weave of Fire, after which it turns to dust. We do not know how they are made, nor how, or even if, they reproduce.
